## Setup and maintain code

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(snakecase) #snake case, all letters of the heading of the table will be low case letters separated by _. name_repair can update column names while we load it. more readable and best practice to use 
```

## Importing new data 
```{r}
# here function, tells R to go back to where the project file is located.
# %>% Pipe, command, shift, P
# we only load in a small part of the dataset to actually be able to read it and see part of the dataset. we can use n_max to tell how many rows will be loaded 
here("data-raw/nurses-stress/stress/5C/5C_1586886626/HR.csv.gz") %>% 
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE, 
           name_repair = to_snake_case, #printer ikke output af, hvad read_csv gætter på, at data er. 
           n_max=100) # only import 100 rows of the dataset 

```
